abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Alvenor improves systolic drop compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor lowers blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Willow Lane Cohort.
